partes.p: [5 Points] Suppose that this economy is initially at a medium-run equilibrium. During the pandemic, many people developed a strong preference for leisure and staying at home. This translated into a lower supply of work for a given wage, which can be viewed as an increase in the catch-all variable $z$ to $z' = z + \Delta z$. Using the IS-LM-PC diagram, show graphically what happens to output $Y$ and inflation $\pi$ in the short run.
